import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"]

    df = readings.copy()

    # Row-level bad determination
    value = df["value"]
    is_bad = value.isna() | (value < 0) | (value > 1000)
    df["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    # Batch-level aggregates
    grp = df.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"]
    total_rows = grp.transform("size")
    bad_rows = grp.transform("sum")

    quarantine_flag = (bad_rows * 100) > (total_rows * 20)

    df["_total_rows"] = total_rows
    df["_bad_rows"] = bad_rows
    df["_quarantine"] = quarantine_flag

    base_cols = list(readings.columns)

    # Quarantined batches: all rows go to quarantine
    quarantine_mask = df["_quarantine"]
    quarantine_df = df.loc[quarantine_mask].copy()
    if not quarantine_df.empty:
        pct = (quarantine_df["_bad_rows"] * 100.0 / quarantine_df["_total_rows"]).round(2)
        quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = pct
    else:
        quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = pd.Series(dtype="float64")

    readings_quarantine = quarantine_df[base_cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Non-quarantined batches: split by row rule
    rest_df = df.loc[~quarantine_mask].copy()

    clean_df = rest_df.loc[~rest_df["_is_bad"]]
    rejects_df = rest_df.loc[rest_df["_is_bad"]]

    readings_clean = clean_df[base_cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    readings_rejects = rejects_df[base_cols].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": readings_clean,
        "readings_rejects": readings_rejects,
        "readings_quarantine": readings_quarantine,
    }
